note: City of Casey's Rutt Park, off I-80: camper lanes and a tent area beside the playground, paved walking path, basketball court and open shelter house. The electric outlets and water hook-ups are new, but the city warns power-intensive campers may still struggle. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15 RV / $10 tent, first come first served, shower house and dump, water hook-ups (amperage not posted). Cleared directory-sourced site count (25), season (May 1-Oct 1), flush toilets and drinking water, which the city's page does not state. Name and phone leads.
